posts.text: Putting aside the word “despise” one objection to Roberts, Vance et al is they are economic progressives with more in common with Elizabeth Warren and Bernie Sanders than Ronald Reagan, who you would also describe as a liberal Republican. And you can deny it all you like but Vance and Roberts want a big tent for populists and nationalists who have animosity for Jews and Israel. And you seem to want them in the tent too.
